BiblicalUsage: Polchan is an Aramaic word for worship, the service of God. It stands once, in Ezra 7:19, where Artaxerxes sends the vessels for the service of the house of God — the worship-vessels for the temple in Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a Persian king's gift became worship when it served the house of God.
